description: La Chalet is a private, modern, rustic, and stylish place. Come with your partner, family or friends, and enjoy a unique experience in direct contact with nature. In the mornings you will hear the birds singing and the murmur of the Ingenio River. It is equipped with all the comforts to ensure a pleasant stay. While you take in the beautiful view, you can enjoy our beautiful pool. We have a gazebo, bathroom and outdoor shower.The space🏡 Welcome to Chalet River Mountain – Airbnb in Aguada, Puerto Rico | Near Rincón and Aguadilla 🇵🇷 West PR📍 Ideal location for exploring Aguada, Rincón, and Aguadilla.🌴 Live the Puerto Rico experience in a cozy and exclusive space.💬 Great for: • Romantic getaways • Family vacations • Sharing in small groups or intimate celebrations (maximum 5 registered guests) • Days of unwinding • Spiritual retreat 🩵🩷 Children are welcome🤍 We accept families with children of any age; they are always welcome. However, it is important that parents supervise minors at all times, as the property has stairs and a pool. For those traveling with babies, it is recommended to bring a playpen and a life jacket for added safety.📲 Access: No partying. La Chalet is a place to enjoy peace, rest and harmony. No unregistered persons are allowed to enter. Visitors are not allowed. ($60 per additional person) 🚗 Access control parking for up to 2 cars. 📍LocationWe are located in a rural area, which means that the route includes curves and hills – something common in many areas of Puerto Rico – but upon arrival, you will be greeted by a unique natural environment.We are located approximately:Minutes (by car) from the best beaches:• 🚗 30 min – Aguadilla Airport• 🌊 25 min – Crash Boat, Aguadilla Beach • 🏖️ 12 min – Pico de Piedra, Aguada Beach• 🌅 21 min – Lighthouse and beaches of RincónNearby you will find: bakeries, gas stations, pharmacies, workshops, stores and auto repair shops. 🏞️ Enjoy the tranquility, the sound and the beautiful view of the Ingenio River. For safety reasons, access to the river is not allowed.⸻⚡️ Energy The villa has electricity and solar power. We urge you to use them responsibly, as air conditioners consume a large amount of energy and the solar system batteries have a limited lifespan in the event of a power outage. • Keep the doors closed at all times to maintain the temperature. • The air conditioners are digitally programmed to optimize energy use. Please do not set the temperature to the coldest setting. ⸻🚪 Security and access • The gate is electric, with access control. It must be kept closed after entering or leaving. • We have security cameras outside that record 24/7: • These cameras record only the exterior areas of the property, including the exterior perimeter, the front and back, the main gate, the parking lot, the gazebo area, and the pool. The cameras are checked in case of emergency, and the recordings are used exclusively in case of security-related situations, in order to protect our guests and the property. • We have a fire extinguisher in the kitchen, near the refrigerator. • Wi-Fi is available inside and outside the chalet. Some mobile companies do not have a good signal, so using Wi-Fi for calls is recommended.⸻🚫 General rules🚭 No smoking:• Smoking inside or around the chalet is not allowed, as the property has smoke detectors.You may only smoke in the designated area in front of the main gate. • No parties or gatherings allowed. Only sharing among people registered in the reservation is allowed (maximum of five guests). • The pool is exclusively for registered guests. • After 9:00 PM, quiet hours must be observed. Use of the pool is allowed after 9:00 pm, but only if you are very quiet. (🔇 No loudspeakers, music, or loud voices after 9:00 PM). • No pets allowed, except for certified service animals. ⸻🛏️ Chalet layoutTop floor: • Master bedroom with rustic staircase, bed, night table, lamp, rocking chair and glass walls with a direct view of the Ingenio River. — 36,000 BTU air conditioning and fan. • When you open the balcony door, you will enjoy a spectacular view and the relaxing sound of the Ingenio River.Ground floor: • Full kitchen: stove, refrigerator, microwave, coffee maker and basic utensils. • Dining room with rustic table and 4 chairs. (There is an additional chair in room 2.) • Living room with decorative fountain, rustic armchair, and TV with internet access. • Full bathroom with water heater and first aid kit. • Towels available based on number of guests. Pool towels are not included.Second room: • Bunk bed (Full/Twin) and nightstand. ❄️ Room with air conditioning and fans.⸻🌊 Pool and outdoor area • Beautiful private swimming pool with gazebo, gas grill, sink, bathroom and outdoor shower. 🔵 Security gate to access the pool. 🔒 Childproof lock for added safety.The villa has a swimming pool protected by a safety gate with a childproof lock, designed to restrict access and provide greater safety for children. However, children must always be under adult supervision while in the pool area. • The pool does not have a heating system; it is at ambient temperature. • The pool LED light automatically turns on for approximately two and a half hours. The pool motor automatically turns on for three hours in the morning and an hour and a half in the evening. 💡 LED light and motor:Both have an automatic timer. It is not possible to adjust them manually or digitally. 💡🔵 The operating times are approximate, as the timer can generate variations of several minutes, up to approximately one hour. • Prohibited: running, jumping, rough play, standing on the edges, eating food, or using glass containers in the pool. • Children under 16 must always be accompanied by an adult. • The gazebo speakers connect via Bluetooth. • The use of speakers is prohibited after 9:00 pm.⸻ • We do not have a washer or dryer. Laundry is available nearby.The Chalet is thoroughly disinfected and sanitized before each stay, using certified, top-quality products. Likewise, the pool is cleaned at the end of each reservation, ensuring a safe, hygienic and comfortable environment for all our guests.⸻⚠️ PrecautionsFor safety, especially with children: • Be careful going up or down stairs. • Do not lean on the balcony or fences. • Wet floors can be slippery both inside and outside the chalet.⸻🛑 Liability • We are not liable for any accidents or injuries that may occur during the stay, either inside or outside the property. The guest assumes full responsibility for their safety and that of their companions. • 🏊‍♂️ Use of the pool is at your own risk. There is no lifeguard. We are not liable for falls, injuries or accidents that occur in the pool area or in the Chalet. 🔵 When using the pool, guests agree to do so with due caution. • For questions or concerns, you can message us through the app. 📌 We reserve the right of admission.⸻🛠️ About the ChaletLa Chalet River Mountain was built with love 🧡, effort and dedication. It opened on May 30, 2025. This space is like your home, and we are a family, ready to serve you with great responsibility. 🙏 We ask you to take care of it as if it were your home. ❤️.Here, comfort, nature 🍂 and a unique experience await you on the beautiful west coast of Puerto Rico. 🇵🇷____✨ Before saying goodbye to Chalet River Mountain… ✨Don't leave without opening the balcony door and treating yourself to one last moment of tranquility. Let the relaxing sound of the Ingenio River accompany your senses as you take in the beautiful natural view that surrounds us. 🌿🏞️💙Guest accessThe access gate to the accommodation is the first, identified with the access control box.The second gate is not part of Chalet River Mountain, as that adjacent land belongs to a future project that is not yet available to the public.We ask that you respect the limits of the listing and do not enter beyond the first gate.Other things to noteMaximum guest capacity: Please make sure to include the exact number of guests in the reservation. Remember that the maximum allowed is 5 guests because the space is limited. If cameras detect additional guests not included in the booking, a $60.00 fee will be charged for each extra person.

title: Casa de Kai | Private Pool & Panoramic Views
description: Please be sure to click “Show more” to read the full listing description, including important details and house rules, before booking. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us - we’re happy to help and look forward to hosting you!The spaceCasa de Kai is a 2-bedroom 2-bathroom villa. We call it the ultimate surfer's retreat. Its ambiance, decor, and character truly define the Rincon lifestyle. If you are looking to relax, experience breathtaking sunsets, enjoy quiet surroundings, swim in a private pool, and still have all the fun and action Rincón has to offer then this is the place for you! The villa is a short drive away from secluded beaches where you can experience calm waters in the Summer and world-class surfing during the Winter season. One of our guest's favorites is Sandy Beach, just a 2-minute drive! Once you get off the main road, you will encounter narrow countryside roads for approx 3-5 minutes until you get to the property.IMPORTANT This property offers a generator & water tank in case of an interruption in electrical or water service.POOL DETAILS & SECURITY CAMERA DISCLAIMER: Casa de Kai has a Ring camera motion sensor security system on the exterior of the property that points towards the driveway, terrace and pool areas. They are located on the balcony of the 2nd floor, at each corner, and can be seen in the pictures.IMPORTANT: THE POOL IS NOT HEATEDIf you have any questions, please let us know before booking. LIVING AREACasa de Kai has a great open living area. You will love the way the living area seamlessly integrates with the kitchen and beautiful terrace. There is a 4-person dining table, small sectional sofa, TV, and AC. The room is furnished with vibrant colors and comfort in mind. The living and dining room opens to the grand terrace via gorgeous stainless steel doors. The modern multi-windows & doors open completely; this way the guest can enjoy the expansive and beautiful views. The terrace has a lounge area, hammocks, a dining table, and a carbon BBQ grill. Casa de Kai's best and ultimate amenity is its private pool. Large enough for all your guests to enjoy and just a brisk walk down some stairs. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSThe master suite has a King-size bed, 2 personal nightstands, TV, ceiling fans, AC, a full dresser, and an on-suite private bathroom. The second bedroom has a bunk bed made up of two full beds with a twin trundle pull out. It also features a small dresser, AC, and sliding door closet. PACK AND PLAY (SUBJECT TO AVAILABILITY): We can leave a complimentary Pack and Play at the property upon request. This should be requested upon booking or no later than 5 days before arrival. Pack and Plays are subject to availability.KITCHENCasa de Kai's kitchen is conveniently located in the living area. It can be described as open and airy since it seamlessly opens toward the terrace. It offers a full refrigerator, toaster, microwave oven, stove, blender, and basically everything you need for an extended stay. Casa de Kai has a laundry room with a washer & dryer, perfect for an extended stay.GETTING AROUND & PARKINGCasa del Kai includes two (2) unassigned parking spots. Renting a car is a must when staying in Rincón. Ubers are not readily available in the area. There are many activities within 15 minutes of driving distance and the roads are easy to navigate. LOCATIONThere are many things to do in Rincón, Puerto Rico. This part of the island is best known as "The town of beautiful sunsets." Staying at Rincón you will enjoy a laid-back atmosphere, delicious restaurants, and great surfing beaches. Here are some of our favorite things to do:Explore the large selection of local restaurants. Some of our favorites include The English Rose, La Cambija, Carta Buena, Kaplash, El Tamboo Beside the Point, The Beach House, and La Copa Llena. Check out a new restaurant called La Serina, a great Tiki bar and sushi bar located downtown. Relax at your personal grand terrace or just a short drive away from Sandy Beach. The apartment includes beach chairs, beach towels, and coolers.Enjoy a beautiful sunset dinner at La Copa Llena.Visit the local beaches like Steps, Maria's Beach, Sandy Beach, Domes Beach, and Corcega.Take a picture of the beautiful "El Faro Lighthouse" at Punta Higuero.Watch an afternoon sunset at Sandy Beach or Marías Beach and stop for a drink at the Calypso Bar which is right by the beach. or The Beach House.Take a paddle-board tour with the folks at Rincon Paddle Boards. Guests can rent surfing boars at The Beach House.Other things to notePlease be sure to click “Show more” to read the full listing description, including important details and house rules, before booking. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us - we’re happy to help and look forward to hosting you!STARTER AMENITIESAt West Indies Vacation Rentals, we strive to provide top-notch amenities, ensuring our guests feel at home during their stay. All properties come with freshly laundered bed linens and towels. We provide 2 bath towels per guest and 1 beach/pool towel per guest.We provide a set of disposable essentials to help you get your vacation started comfortably. These include:- 1 set of hotel-size soap and shampoo (per bathroom)- 3 garbage bags- 1 roll of paper towels- 2 rolls of toilet paper (per bathroom)- 1 dish soap- 1 dish sponge- A small amount of laundry detergent [PATRICIA ESTO LO DEJAS SI LA PROPIEDAD TIENE LAVADORA, SI NO LO QUITAS PARA QUE EL A.I. DE ALGUNOS CANALES O EL GUEST NO VAYA A PENSAR ERRONAMENTE QUE HAY LAVADORA AQUI]Please note that we do not provide unlimited disposable amenities. It is the guest’s responsibility to review what is included in the property and stock any additional items needed for the duration of the stay.Most properties also include at least 2 beach chairs and an ice cooler. You may reach out to us 5 days before arrival for confirmation. CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT TIMESCheck-in begins at 4:00 PM, and since this is a self-check-in unit, you can arrive anytime after that.If you’d like to check in earlier, please contact us the day before your arrival, and we’ll confirm availability. When possible, early check-in typically starts around 11:00 AM. Please note that early check-in is subject to availability and depends on our cleaning schedule.If you need a guaranteed early check-in, you will need to book from the night prior to ensure the property is ready upon your arrival.Check-out time is at 11:00 AM. For late check-out requests, please reach out the day before your departure, and we’ll be happy to check availability for you.INSTANT & LAST-MINUTE BOOKING POLICYInstant Booking is available if reserved at least 2 days before check-in.For same-day or next-day reservations, availability depends on our cleaning schedule. You’re welcome to send a booking request, but please note that this does not guarantee the unit is booked—all requests must be reviewed and approved by our team. Requests sent late at night may not be reviewed until the following day, and same-day bookings are usually not accepted after 6:00 PM.We appreciate your understanding!HOUSE RULESNO SMOKING: Smoking is not permitted anywhere on the property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged if this rule is violated.NO PETS: While we are pet lovers, pets are not permitted at the property at any time. A $300 fine will be charged if this rule is violated, and guests may be asked to leave the property.QUIET HOURS: Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM. Please be mindful of noise during these hours out of respect for nearby residents/neighbors.UTILITIES (WATER & ELECTRICITY): In the event of an interruption to water or electrical service, the host is not responsible for hotel, alternate lodging, or transportation expenses. If service is interrupted for more than 3 hours, guests may cancel the reservation and request a refund for unused nights only. Nights already used are non-refundable.MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY: The maximum occupancy is 5 adults/children at all times, including visitors. OCCUPANCY ENFORCEMENT: Occupancy limits are strictly enforced. Exceeding the maximum occupancy may result in immediate cancellation of the reservation or removal from the property without refund.TOWELS & LINENS: Towels and linens are provided for normal use only. Please do not use them for cleaning or allow them to be stained with food, grease, or other substances. Charges may apply for damaged or stained items. TOWEL HANGING: Please do not hang towels or any other items to dry in areas visible from outside the unit. A $100 community fine may apply if this rule is violated.SUBLETTING: Subletting or re-renting the property is not permitted.TRAVEL INSURANCE / HURRICANE SEASONWe strongly recommend that all guests purchase travel insurance, not only during the peak months of Hurricane Season (July to October) but also throughout the year to cover unexpected events such as travel delays, pandemics, or other unforeseen issues.Travel insurance is inexpensive and can reimburse travelers for most expenses associated with canceling travel outside of the cancellation window; however, coverage will depend on the policy purchased. Make sure to review and understand the options before purchase.DISCLAIMER: We are not associated with any travel insurance companies.INTERACTION WITH GUESTSWe want your stay at West Indies Vacation Rental to be smooth and enjoyable. You can message us anytime after booking with questions. Starting 5 days before arrival, your designated Property Manager will also be available to answer any additional questions you may have prior to arrival. You’ll get all the essential property information 48 hours before arrival, as well as the Property Manager’s direct contact, so you’ll have support when you need it - before, during, and after your stay.

Cristal windows let in light but cannot be open to prevent damage to A/C and unwanted bugs inside room.Guest accessThe room has a lockbox with the key inside next to its door.
